mechanism.claim: General-purpose-tech value migrates to DEPLOYERS with pricing power ('the factories, not GE'): electrification's economics accrued to factory owners who reorganized around it, not to the equipment vendors. AI analog: ops-heavy incumbents with moats convert back-office labor (servicing, claims, title search, underwriting ops, collections, KYC, RCM) into software cost; where sector structure lets them KEEP the spread, opex/revenue falls and margins inflect BEFORE consensus models it.

RPA failed (b) everywhere; mortgage automation passed (a) and was therefore competed away fast.
